node.name: Write one ImportLog row for each payment
node.logic: BTS.AddImportLog in the practice DB. ilProcess='Process_BBVA_835Patient'. ilLogLevel 2/'Finished' if ErrorCount='0', else 0/'Failed'. ilImportGUID = BizTalk MessageID. ilExternalReference = PaymentIdentifier. ilMessage = ResponseMessage. An exception stops the loop and writes only to the Windows event log.
